text: BUTTRESS, a kind of batment built archwife, or a mals of flouse or birds, ferving to prop of flapper the fides of a building, wall, 6e, on the outside, where it is either very high, or has any considerable load to fultain on the other fide, as a bank of earth, eC

parsed.faithful: BUTTRESS, a kind of butment built archwife, or a mafs of flone or brick, ferving to prop or fupport the fides of a building, wall, &c. on the outside, where it is either very high, or has any confiderable load to fupport on the other fide, as a bank of earth, &c.
parsed.modern: BUTTRESS, a kind of butment built archwife, or a mass of stone or brick, serving to prop or support the sides of a building, wall, &c. on the outside, where it is either very high, or has any considerable load to support on the other side, as a bank of earth, &c.
